name: W32-G104 the payments nested under an invoice leave out a payment with no journal, the credit sold on due
find:
'SELECT p.sale_id, p.payment_id, p.payment_time, SUM(l.credit - l.debit) AS paid
                 FROM ' . $this->db->prefixTable('sales_payments') . ' p
                 JOIN ' . $this->db->prefixTable('accounting_journals') . " j ON j.source_type = ? AND j.source_id = p.payment_id AND {$standing}
                 JOIN " . $this->db->prefixTable('accounting_journal_lines') . ' l ON l.journal_id = j.journal_id
                 JOIN ' . $this->db->prefixTable('accounting_accounts') . ' a ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND (a.entity_type = ? OR a.account_id = ?)
                 WHERE p.sale_id IN (' . implode(',', array_map('intval', $chunk)) . ')
replace:
'SELECT p.sale_id, p.payment_id, p.payment_time, COALESCE(SUM(l.credit - l.debit), p.payment_amount) AS paid
                 FROM ' . $this->db->prefixTable('sales_payments') . ' p
                 LEFT JOIN ' . $this->db->prefixTable('accounting_journals') . " j ON j.source_type = ? AND j.source_id = p.payment_id AND {$standing}
                 LEFT JOIN " . $this->db->prefixTable('accounting_journal_lines') . ' l ON l.journal_id = j.journal_id
                 LEFT JOIN ' . $this->db->prefixTable('accounting_accounts') . ' a ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND (a.entity_type = ? OR a.account_id = ?)
                 WHERE p.sale_id IN (' . implode(',', array_map('intval', $chunk)) . ')
